Scale: the plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across. The scrambled eggs cover about 20% of the plate and are around 3 cm high. That is a volume of about 200 ml, and fluffy eggs at roughly 0.7 g/ml come to about 140 g. The roasted sweet potato cubes cover about 12% of the plate and are about 2.5 cm high. That is roughly 120 g. There is also a small amount of hot sauce or paprika on the eggs, about 5 g.
